character: Fast, flowing Tuscan circuit through rolling hills, owned by Ferrari. High-speed corners dominate, especially the flat-out Arrabbiata pair; smooth commitment through the fast sections defines lap time.

corners.name: San Donato
corners.type: tight right-hander off the front straight (Turn 1)
corners.trap: Over-braking and losing momentum into the following section

corners.name: Arrabbiata 1 & 2
corners.type: two of the quickest corners on the circuit, taken close to flat-out
corners.technique: Minimal steering input, trust the grip, commit fully
corners.trap: Any lift or correction at this speed scrubs enormous time

corners.name: Casanova-Savelli
corners.technique: Smooth, rhythmic direction changes, carry momentum through the sequence
corners.trap: Over-driving any single apex disrupts the whole complex

corners.name: Bucine
corners.type: final, long corner before the main straight
corners.technique: Late apex, progressive throttle, clean exit is critical
corners.trap: Early throttle here compromises the entire run down the front straight
